standards.title: Water Supply - Materials and products
standards.description: All materials and products in contact with drinking water must comply with AS/NZS 4020 and be WaterMark certified.

standards.title: Sanitary Plumbing - Pipe sizes
standards.description: Minimum pipe size for a single basin is 40mm. Minimum size for WC is 100mm.

standards.title: On-site wastewater management
standards.description: Requires advanced secondary treatment for highly sensitive catchments.
